purpose: Teach: 歯ブラシ/酪農/石器/ニワトリ/和紙/魚介類/アヒル/下駄

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい歯ブラシを買ってあげるわね
lines.en: Sho, I'm going to buy you a new toothbrush.
lines.style: Warm, almost offhand. A small gift offered with tenderness that doesn't need announcement. Soft voice, the kind of care that shows up in daily life.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママと酪農体験に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to a dairy farm with Mom!
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick opening. Words tumble out with genuine excitement. Looking for her reaction, wanting her to understand why it was important.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが石器のレプリカを買ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home a replica of a stone tool.
lines.style: Gentle observation, noticing something he might find interesting. Quiet reverence in the tone — not performing wonder, but aware of it. Inviting him to see what she sees.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、田舎でニワトリ見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw chickens out in the countryside!
lines.style: Breathless, eager to report back. His voice bright with fresh discovery. Waiting for her to understand — this is something new, something he wants to tell her first.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが和紙のしおりをくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, I have a washi paper bookmark to give you.
lines.style: Soft unveiling. Pause before 'have' — the gift matters in its simplicity. Quiet warmth. She's been thinking of him, and this is the evidence, delivered gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと魚介類のお店に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to a seafood restaurant with Dad!
lines.style: A request woven with longing. Open, earnest. He's imagining it aloud — the specific detail ('seafood restaurant') shows he's really thought about it. Seeking permission and her engagement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、池にアヒルが浮かんでるわね
lines.en: Sho, there's a duck floating on the pond.
lines.style: Soft-focus observation, almost dreamy. Pointing gently toward something small and present. Her voice is the quiet before beauty — not urgent, but inviting him to notice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りで下駄を履いてみたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to try wearing geta at the festival!
lines.style: Wanting confirmation, asking like he's admitting something cherished. Voice a little higher with anticipation. He trusts her reaction will match his hope.
